recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-8775 unless a future work group decision changes the example value for unrelated reasons.
issue_request: FHIR-8775 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the search page. It reported that the DiagnosticReport result.code-value-quantity example used 5.5 while the explanatory text described a potassium value of >5.4 mmol/L, and asked that the example and explanation use either 5.5 or 5.4 consistently.
initial_application: SVN revision 7152, imported as git commit 4c785161a2c47ee43d7b527603ee3521b38cc6f5 with subject "#8775 - fix typos in search examples", changed the affected source/search.html example from $gt5.5 to $gt5.4.
additional_context: The current source/search.html page now uses the HTTP GET/POST example markup, and both forms use result.code-value-quantity=http://loinc.org|2823-3$gt5.4|http://unitsofmeasure.org|mmol/L while the adjacent description says >5.4 mmol/L. Jira search found only FHIR-8775 for the same example terms, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the applied correction.
